title: Structural, thermodynamics, and mechanistic insights into a tobacco-waste derived activated carbon/polysaccharide composite sponge for efficient Cr(VI) adsorption and reusability
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48816-48846
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07331F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahlem Guesmi, Naoufel Ben Hamadi, Wesam Abd El-Fattah, Mohamed A. El-Bindary, Mohamed G. El-Desouky, Ashraf A. El-Bindary
This study introduces TACGC, a bioadsorbent made from tobacco processing residues, and evaluates its effectiveness in adsorbing hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI)) from water.
